disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of Cd, Cr, Pb, Ni, Mn, Fe and Zn in vegetables from peri-urban markets of Rawalpindi and Multan, reported as mean ± SD on a dry-weight basis.

study.design: Market survey of 12 vegetables from peri-urban markets in two Punjab regions, with intake survey
study.origin: peri-urban areas of Multan and Rawalpindi, Punjab, Pakistan (grown locally per title)
study.market: six peri-urban markets, Multan and Rawalpindi regions
study.method: GF-AAS (Varian AA240) for Cd, Cr, Pb, Ni (flame implied for Mn, Fe, Zn) after HNO3/HClO4 hot-plate digestion of dehydrated (55-60 °C) samples
